Job Requirements

Job Requirements

Role/ Job Title: Principal Data Analyst

Function/ Department: Data & Analytics

Job Purpose

The Principal Data Analyst plays a critical role in providing robust analytical support to the organization. They leverage data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning methods, and optimization techniques to drive data-driven decision-making

Roles & Responsibilities

Develop and enhance business and functional requirements in collaboration with business and technology teams.
Configure interfaces to source metadata from various sources for Metadata management products.
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to Data Center Orchestration (DCO) tools.
Support installations and configurations of DCO, Orchestrator (OO), and Server Automation (SA) products.
Mentor peers in the use, administration, and customization of DCO team tools and applications.
Customize and extend Data Center Orchestration tools based on business requirements.
Develop automation scripts (Python, Shell, PERL, Visual Basic, batch files) for system and application administration.

Managerial And Leadership Responsibilities

Provide technical direction to the engineering team.
Collaborate with sales and client partners to develop new business and manage existing client relationships.
Contribute to thought leadership in the big data space through white papers and industry conferences.

Education Qualification

Graduation: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)

Post-Graduation: Master of Science (M.Sc) /Master of Technology (M.Tech) / Master of Computer Applications (MCA)

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience.
